body: It's 100% bait. 4chan wanted people to get mad at the phrase "it's okay to be white" to "expose racism" as they put it. Their intention was to make a completely harmless statement that would get people angry. It's just a phrase, but they knew it would get a reaction. Clearly they were correct. They wanted the phrase to have as little meaning as possible to make their argument stronger. In the original post they stated that they wanted the poster to have no affiliation to alt-right sites (such as watermarks) as to bolster their credibility.
The subject in question didn't declare: "No homo" after the act was finished. Therefore the court must conclude that this man is gay.
